name: Danshi Ryou Himitsu no Idol
original_name: 男子寮ヒミツのアイドル
source:
Even though your twin brother was set to enter the show business, he suddenly disappeared?!

Despite having no clue as to why, being his older sister you decide to start dressing up as him and debut in his stead.

A more experienced idol from the same company and one from another, your manager, even the overbearing company president... Your exciting life at the (hot) boys' dorms is about to begin.

And remember: you must not tell anyone that you're actually a girl!

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101125052907/http://www.furyu.jp/mobile/otome/danshiryo/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
明明已经决定进入演艺圈，你的双胞胎弟弟，却突然失踪了？！

虽然完全摸不清缘由，身为姐姐的你，还是决定女扮男装，代替弟弟出道。

同公司的前辈偶像、其他公司的偶像、你的经纪人，甚至还有强势的公司总裁……与帅哥们共处男子宿舍的刺激生活，即将开始。

记住，绝不能让任何人知道，你其实是女孩！

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101125052907/http://www.furyu.jp/mobile/otome/danshiryo/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
